import importlib.util, time, random
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m","/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
# measure exhaustive fallback cost with 20 items
items = [(random.getrandbits(20)|1, random.randint(1,1000), "q%02d"%i) for i in range(20)]
full = (1<<20)-1
t0=time.time(); r = m._exhaustive_cover(items, full); dt=time.time()-t0
print("exhaustive 20 items: %.2fs" % dt, r[:2])
# adversarial for B&B: many similar masks
random.seed(1)
worst=0; worstcase=None
for trial in range(300):
    npairs=28; n=20
    items=[]
    for i in range(n):
        mask = random.getrandbits(npairs)
        if mask==0: mask=1
        items.append((mask, random.randint(1,1000), "q%02d"%i))
    cov=0
    for it in items: cov|=it[0]
    full=(1<<npairs)-1
    if cov!=full: continue
    t0=time.time(); sol=m._solve_cover(items, full, npairs); dt=time.time()-t0
    if dt>worst: worst=dt; worstcase=(items,sol)
print("worst B&B time %.3fs" % worst)
# classic hard set cover families: 20 sets over 28 universe
